packageRules.description: The example app's runtime versions are dictated by the installed Expo SDK, and expo-doctor fails the build when they drift. The shared preset names the usual suspects; this widens it to every runtime dependency the example app declares. Refresh the lockfile inside the declared ranges, never widen them. SDK jumps are done by hand.

Stricter than the shared preset, which only holds react-native to in-range. packages/modal builds and tests against the same react-native the example app runs, which the Expo SDK dictates. Bumping it on its own installs a second copy and expo-doctor fails on the duplicate. Moves by hand with the SDK.
